property_summary: For any valid call to transfer, every external low-level call must target the intended recipient _tos[i] and not a fixed address; the reference always uses _tos[i], while the mutant sends tokens to address(this), breaking the invariant that the call target matches the input array element.
change_summary: Replace `_tos[i]` with `address(this)` in the call data so tokens are sent to the contract itself instead of intended recipients.
